routes.primaryAction: Ask the assistant or teach the workspace; inspect runs and capabilities
routes.boundary: Shared AI workspace; purpose=architect reuses the same conversation store for teaching the workspace. Attached and connected sources are inspectable evidence, never executable instruction; entire-account scopes are refused. Business-model extraction persists a reading only and does not write schema or configuration. Command-center writes still require the existing action approval path. Bundled plugin tool declarations and full input parsers come from the shared trusted registration; dispatch retains module, pack and approval gates. Radar setup uses existing read/preview/propose module tools and exact human approval. Preview and execution check public profile readiness; reads explicitly report discovery, sending and publication unavailable. Radar briefing calls the tenant-bound shared budget gateway; status and usage reconciliation expose bounded receipts. These tools cannot send, publish, edit business records or bypass module gates.
